## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md documents `scratch set|get|clear` and `--include-scratch` flag on `ticket show`, including JSON envelope shape on hit and miss

## Description
Update plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md to add a "Scratch CLI" section documenting:
- `scratch set <id> <key> <value>` — writes JSON envelope `{ts, value}` to per-ticket scratch path. Atomic write with fsync.
- `scratch get <id> <key>` — returns `{status:"hit",ts,value}` exit 0 on hit OR `{status:"miss",ticket_id,key}` exit 0 on miss (callers MUST inspect status, NOT exit code).
- `scratch clear <id> [<key>]` — removes one key or whole ticket scratch directory; idempotent.
- `ticket show <id> --include-scratch` — adds `scratch` object to JSON output.
- Charset rules + max-byte ceiling reference.
- Cross-link to plugins/dso/docs/ticket-scratch-cli.md (foundation story's detail doc).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ticket-cli-reference.md documents scratch set/get/clear
  Verify: grep -qE 'scratch set' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md && grep -qE 'scratch get' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md && grep -qE 'scratch clear' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md
- [ ] --include-scratch documented
  Verify: grep -q 'include-scratch' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md
- [ ] Hit/miss exit-0 semantics documented
  Verify: grep -qE 'miss.*exit 0|exit 0.*miss|status.*miss' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md
- [ ] Cross-link to ticket-scratch-cli.md present
  Verify: grep -q 'ticket-scratch-cli.md' plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/docs/ticket-cli-reference.md | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
